question: #12628 at 808a9cf8 against main: on a hover reveal, does the action take no click while its opacity is near 0? Does focus reveal at once, and is reduced motion instant?

stories.image: core-overlay--hover-on-image (the same story on both builds)

method.layer: the overlay's .astryx-overlay-scrim element; opacity, visibility, clip-path and pointer-events are its computed values; hit: elementFromPoint at the action's center returns the action or a child
method.hover: the pointer enters the image 24 px in from its corner, away from the action; every frame from pointerenter for 600 ms; reduced motion off and on
method.tab: focus starts on the page; Tab until focus leaves the story; each stop is sampled on every frame for 400 ms, timed from focusin
method.unhover: the overlay shown by hover for 600 ms, then the pointer leaves; every frame from pointerleave for 600 ms
method.thresholds: shown: opacity above 0.001; fully shown: opacity at least 0.999
method.paint: each painted screencast frame after pointerenter: the mean |frame - rest| inside the overlay box over the mean |settled - rest| (0 = rest, 1 = settled); 3 runs per build and mode
method.computedTransitions: the layer's computed transition-property, -duration and -delay at rest, on hover and under focus-within, reduced motion off and on
